#+title: habshe-emacs — early initialization
#+author: A. Shehab (habshehabshe)

Runs before the first frame exists and before package activation.
Owns everything that must be true at frame-creation time: frame
chrome, frame sizing behavior, package suppression, and GC
headroom for the init phase.

#+begin_src emacs-lisp :tangle "../early-init.el"
  ;;; early-init.el --- GENERATED from org/early-init.org — do not edit -*- lexical-binding: t; -*-

  ;; Suppress package.el's automatic activation: init.el drives package
  ;; setup (activation + install pass) at a chosen point. setq is
  ;; deliberate here — package.el is not loaded yet, so `setopt' cannot
  ;; see the option; this is the documented exception.
  (setq package-enable-at-startup nil)

  ;; Frame chrome: disabled before the first frame is mapped, so no bar
  ;; ever flashes on screen.
  (menu-bar-mode -1)
  (tool-bar-mode -1)
  (scroll-bar-mode -1)

  ;; Frames size to exact pixels and do not resize when fonts change.
  (setopt frame-resize-pixelwise t)
  (setopt frame-inhibit-implied-resize t)

  ;; GC headroom while init runs; restored once init is done.
  (setq gc-cons-threshold most-positive-fixnum)

  (defun my-early-init--restore-gc ()
    "Restore the garbage collector after initialization.
The conservative default suits interactive editing far better
than the unbounded threshold used during startup."
    (setq gc-cons-threshold 800000))

  (add-hook 'after-init-hook #'my-early-init--restore-gc)
#+end_src
